form_plan.primary_theme_description: Nostalgic A minor theme with driving bass and arpeggiated harmony, evoking Polish sci-fi comic 80s.

sections.description: Main theme introduction over A minor groove
Quiet breakdown with bell ornaments and soft percussion
High variation of the C major theme
F major bridge with descending melody
Transition back to A minor with snare roll
Return of main theme with full arrangement
High variation of the return theme
Short coda ending on A minor

intent.composition_notes: An A minor piece with modulations to C and F major. Uses POKEY channels: lead melody, harmony arpeggios, bass, and percussion. Silence and rests are used in A1 harmony for breathing room. The A-B-A form spans 90 seconds at 60 BPM.
